The '''Arrocharian Militia''' was the main [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Arrochar]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] attempted to set up their new base on Arrochar, but the leader of the Militia planned to deliver the Rebels to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
